name: Multi-Agent Fact-Checker
oneLiner: Two AI models argue every claim in a video script, and an arbiter settles it with live sources.
problem: Fact-checking a long video script took about seven hours of source hunting. One model can't be trusted with it: it hallucinates with confidence and cites nothing. The question was whether two models could keep each other honest.
built: Claim extraction: the script is split into statements that can each be verified.
Two competing agents check every claim independently, with live web evidence, and score their own confidence.
An arbiter weighs their confidence and settles disagreements, which is exactly where a human should look.
proof: Got me the internship, then I rebuilt it in production at Finary: 7 hours → 10 minutes per script.
